# Core architecture lens 0.6.0

The criteria every design is assessed against, whatever it is built from. They ask whether the design answers its demand, sits correctly on the continuum, moves it toward its target state, says how it meets its quality attributes, records its decisions, and can be operated, afforded and changed. Security appears here only as architecture: trust boundaries, identity and the placement of controls. Whether those controls are implemented and effective is a cybersecurity assessment's question, handed over, not answered here.

Applies to always. Source: [`standards/assessment/lenses/core.yaml`](../../standards/assessment/lenses/core.yaml).

## DEM: Demand and drivers

Does the design answer a stated demand, for stated stakeholders, within stated constraints?

| Criterion | Question | Severity | Decided by |
|---|---|---|---|
| [CORE-DEM-01](core-dem-01.md) | Does the design state its goals, its non-goals and its stakeholders with their concerns? | blocker | both |
| [CORE-DEM-02](core-dem-02.md) | Is each goal traceable to an outcome, a use case or a capability, or explicitly recorded as an assumption? | major | both |
| [CORE-DEM-03](core-dem-03.md) | Are the constraints and assumptions stated, each with its source? | minor | reviewer |

## TRC: Place on the continuum

Can the design be traced up to the capabilities and outcomes it serves and down to what will run?

| Criterion | Question | Severity | Decided by |
|---|---|---|---|
| [CORE-TRC-01](core-trc-01.md) | Does the design name the capabilities it realises, the platform it belongs to and the bounded contexts it touches? | major | tool |
| [CORE-TRC-02](core-trc-02.md) | Does the design's type agree with its abstraction? | major | tool |
| [CORE-TRC-03](core-trc-03.md) | Does a reference architecture or solution design name what it implements? | minor | tool |
| [CORE-TRC-04](core-trc-04.md) | Is every functional scenario tied to a use case, and does every use case the design serves have a scenario? | major | tool |

## TGT: Target state

Does the design move the continuum toward its target state, with every departure from it decided and bounded?

| Criterion | Question | Severity | Decided by |
|---|---|---|---|
| [CORE-TGT-01](core-tgt-01.md) | Is every catalogued artefact the design uses at target or in flight, never retired, and does each one still at baseline have a decision naming what it moves to? | major | tool |
| [CORE-TGT-02](core-tgt-02.md) | Is every departure from the target state recorded as a decision, and is a time-bound one given an expiry and a path back? | major | both |
| [CORE-TGT-03](core-tgt-03.md) | Does the design move its capabilities toward the target state, rather than adding to what is being retired or creating a dependency that blocks a planned retirement? | major | reviewer |
| [CORE-TGT-04](core-tgt-04.md) | Where the design shows the target state to be wrong, has that been raised as a consideration to change the target, rather than worked around? | minor | reviewer |
| [CORE-TGT-05](core-tgt-05.md) | Is every building block the target state does not plan for, or holds where it is, brought in or extended only by an exception approved through escalation? | blocker | tool |

## STR: Structure

Are the elements the right kind and grain, inside the right boundaries?

| Criterion | Question | Severity | Decided by |
|---|---|---|---|
| [CORE-STR-01](core-str-01.md) | Is every building block at container grain, never a component or a whole system? | major | reviewer |
| [CORE-STR-02](core-str-02.md) | Does every ABB, SBB, service and store live in exactly one bounded context? | major | tool |
| [CORE-STR-03](core-str-03.md) | Does the realisation chain hold, with no orphans? | minor | tool |
| [CORE-STR-04](core-str-04.md) | Is every service deployed to a node, and every store owned by one service? | minor | tool |
| [CORE-STR-05](core-str-05.md) | Does every element and connector reference resolve? | blocker | tool |
| [CORE-STR-06](core-str-06.md) | Is every element owned by a team? | minor | tool |
| [CORE-STR-07](core-str-07.md) | Do platform dependencies run down the landscape and through contracts only? | major | reviewer |

## QA: Quality attributes

Does the design say, with measures, how it meets the qualities that matter, and what it trades?

| Criterion | Question | Severity | Decided by |
|---|---|---|---|
| [CORE-QA-01](core-qa-01.md) | Does the design state quality-attribute scenarios with a stimulus, a response and a measurable response measure? | blocker | both |
| [CORE-QA-02](core-qa-02.md) | Are the qualities that matter covered, and is each omission deliberate? | major | both |
| [CORE-QA-03](core-qa-03.md) | Are the scenarios prioritised by importance and difficulty, and do the high, high scenarios have a design response? | minor | both |
| [CORE-QA-04](core-qa-04.md) | Are failure scenarios stated for the dependencies the design cannot control? | major | both |
| [CORE-QA-05](core-qa-05.md) | Are the trade-offs between qualities identified and recorded as decisions? | major | reviewer |

## DEC: Decisions and open questions

Are the significant decisions recorded with their alternatives, and the open questions named?

| Criterion | Question | Severity | Decided by |
|---|---|---|---|
| [CORE-DEC-01](core-dec-01.md) | Is each significant decision recorded with its alternatives and rationale? | major | both |
| [CORE-DEC-02](core-dec-02.md) | Is every open question named as a consideration, with who answers it and by when, or the design states it has none? | major | reviewer |
| [CORE-DEC-03](core-dec-03.md) | Is every consideration resolved by an accepted decision before the design is accepted? | major | tool |
| [CORE-DEC-04](core-dec-04.md) | Are one-way-door decisions identified and given proportionate scrutiny? | minor | both |
| [CORE-DEC-05](core-dec-05.md) | Is debt taken on knowingly recorded against the decision that took it on? | minor | reviewer |

## INT: Interfaces and contracts

Is every interaction carried by a versioned contract, with coupling that is deliberate?

| Criterion | Question | Severity | Decided by |
|---|---|---|---|
| [CORE-INT-01](core-int-01.md) | Does every connector that crosses a bounded context or the design's boundary carry a versioned contract? | major | tool |
| [CORE-INT-02](core-int-02.md) | Is the context-map relationship of every cross-context connector stated, and is it the right one? | minor | both |
| [CORE-INT-03](core-int-03.md) | Is coupling deliberate, with strong integration kept close and distant integration kept to contracts? | minor | reviewer |

## DAT: Data

Is every significant data set owned, classified and traced?

| Criterion | Question | Severity | Decided by |
|---|---|---|---|
| [CORE-DAT-01](core-dat-01.md) | Is every significant data set named with an owner and a classification? | major | both |
| [CORE-DAT-02](core-dat-02.md) | Are residency, retention and lineage stated for personal and restricted data? | major | tool |
| [CORE-DAT-03](core-dat-03.md) | Does each data set have one owner, and are other writers going through its owner's contract? | minor | reviewer |

## SEC: Security architecture

Are trust boundaries, identity and the placement of controls designed, and is the security assessment handed over?

| Criterion | Question | Severity | Decided by |
|---|---|---|---|
| [CORE-SEC-01](core-sec-01.md) | Are trust zones declared and every element placed in one? | major | tool |
| [CORE-SEC-02](core-sec-02.md) | Is every connector that crosses a trust boundary authenticated and authorised? | blocker | tool |
| [CORE-SEC-03](core-sec-03.md) | Is every path that carries untrusted content identified, and is that content validated before it is acted on? | major | both |
| [CORE-SEC-04](core-sec-04.md) | Does a threat model exist for this version of the design, and has the cybersecurity assessment been handed over? | major | tool |
| [CORE-SEC-05](core-sec-05.md) | Do services and agents run as their own least-privileged identities rather than shared accounts? | major | reviewer |

## OPS: Operability

Can the design be observed, deployed, rolled back and recovered, against stated objectives?

| Criterion | Question | Severity | Decided by |
|---|---|---|---|
| [CORE-OPS-01](core-ops-01.md) | Are service level objectives stated for what users depend on? | major | tool |
| [CORE-OPS-02](core-ops-02.md) | Can the running design be observed through logs, metrics, traces and an audit trail, to stated conventions? | major | tool |
| [CORE-OPS-03](core-ops-03.md) | Are deployment, rollback, recovery objectives and a degraded mode stated? | minor | tool |
| [CORE-OPS-04](core-ops-04.md) | Is there a runbook, or a commitment to one before the design is in service? | minor | tool |

## CST: Cost and sustainability

Is the running cost modelled and bounded, and the environmental cost considered?

| Criterion | Question | Severity | Decided by |
|---|---|---|---|
| [CORE-CST-01](core-cst-01.md) | Is the running cost modelled, with a unit cost and a budget? | major | tool |
| [CORE-CST-02](core-cst-02.md) | Is the environmental cost of the design considered where it is material? | advisory | reviewer |

## EVO: Evolvability

Will the design stay true after it is built, and can it change?

| Criterion | Question | Severity | Decided by |
|---|---|---|---|
| [CORE-EVO-01](core-evo-01.md) | Are the architecture's important characteristics protected by fitness functions, automated where they can be? | major | both |
| [CORE-EVO-02](core-evo-02.md) | Are the parts most likely to change isolated behind contracts, so they can change without the rest? | minor | reviewer |

## RSK: Risk and obligations

Are the known risks owned, and the obligations the design must meet named?

| Criterion | Question | Severity | Decided by |
|---|---|---|---|
| [CORE-RSK-01](core-rsk-01.md) | Does every known risk have a mitigation, an owner and its residual level? | major | tool |
| [CORE-RSK-02](core-rsk-02.md) | Are the regulatory, contractual and policy obligations named, with how the design classes under each? | major | reviewer |
| [CORE-RSK-03](core-rsk-03.md) | Does the evidence cited exist, cover what it claims and date from this version of the design? | major | reviewer |
